mandatoryFindings.title: Optimization removes outer loader integrity checks before adapter compilation
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Four actual-loader fake-boundary cases independently confirm wrong expected SHA is denied normally but reaches adapter compile/requested execution under optimize=1. Adapter execution was intercepted. No actual host optimization setting is claimed.

Keep common guard/ordinary/postclose literal and exact interfaces/hash/proofs synchronized, preserving same-buffer compilation and ordinary/optimized denial pairs.

mandatoryFindings.title: Relay stop custody-check exception leaves actual result falsely eligible for main custody discharge
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Actual Relay.start opens parent then rejects a fake changed parent-chain. Actual stop marks threadTerminated/descriptorsClosed true before check_custody throws and before parent.close. Effects.stop_relay publishes a copied unqualified receipt but leaves actual relay.result true/true. Actual main finally closes control/output and does not retain Effects although parent remains unclosed. Main remains1; no ordinary0 or real live-thread race is claimed. Joined-close, live-thread and explicit-close-error controls pass.

Any stop/custody exception must leave actual owned result and published receipt consistently unqualified for discharge. Retain Effects/control/output/relay/thread/authority references on partial state until confirmed closure or separate exact disposition.
